title: Audit entry detail view
description: Click row to see full payload and linked resources (navigate to job, workflow, policy).
definitionOfDone: Click table row expands or opens detail panel
Shows full event payload as formatted JSON
Linked resources: clickable links to job, workflow, policy, or user detail pages

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/audit/AuditEntryDetail.tsx: Expandable detail panel for audit entries. Click table row expands inline (accordion style) or opens side panel. Shows full event payload as formatted JSON in a pre/code block (syntax highlighted via CSS, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML). Linked resources: clickable links based on resourceType — 'job' links to /jobs/:id, 'workflow' to /workflows/:id, 'policy' to /policies, 'user' to /settings (users tab). Close button or click row again to collapse.
implementationPlan.note: Created inline expandable detail row. Shows header with event badge + timestamp, message, metadata grid (actor, action, resource type, resource ID), linked resource navigation (job/workflow/policy/user/pack/approval), and full payload as formatted JSON in a pre block. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
